Add a Collapsible Layers & Basemap Control (add_layers_control)

Source: R/controls.R
add_layers_control.Rd

Drop-in GPU equivalent of leaflet::addLayersControl(). Adds a collapsible control (defaulting to "top-right" or "top-left") with radio buttons for switching baseGroups ("Light", "Dark", "Satellite", etc.) and checkboxes for toggling overlayGroups ("Risks", "Claims", "Precipitation", etc.). Also emits input$<mapId>_groups in Shiny so existing leaflet observers work with zero changes!

Usage

add_layers_control(
  map,
  baseGroups = c("Light", "Dark", "Satellite"),
  overlayGroups = character(0),
  position = "top-left",
  options = layers_control_options(),
  order = 10
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

baseGroups

Character vector of basemap group names (default c("Light", "Dark", "Satellite")).

overlayGroups

Character vector of overlay group names.

position

Anchor position in the 9-zone layout grid (default "top-left").

options

Options list from layers_control_options() (e.g., list(collapsed = TRUE)).

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 10).
